title: Merchandise Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 Toram Creators Private Limited is a knitwear and apparel manufacturer based in Tirupur, Tamil Nadu. Founded in 2003, we operate across multiple production units with end\-to\-end capabilities spanning product development, sampling, quality control, and finishing.
 



 We serve a strong portfolio of domestic retail and export brands — including Walmart, GAP, and Fruit of the Loom — delivering across inner garments, knitwear, and lifestyle apparel. Our facilities are certified for SEDEX, BCI, and Disney FAMA.
 



 We are in an active phase of organisational growth — building systems, strengthening our team, and investing in the people and processes that will define the next chapter of Toram. This role is part of that build.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a Merchandising Manager to own the day\-to\-day execution of our brand accounts and lead our merchandising team.
 



 Toram currently runs three active brand accounts, each managed by a senior merchandiser. This role exists to sit above that team — to see across all three accounts simultaneously, hold the merchandisers accountable to TNA and quality standards, own buyer communication at the execution level, and ensure that nothing falls through the gap between an order landing and a shipment going out.
 



 Our Managing Director owns the strategic buyer relationship — new orders, quarterly reviews, and account\-level commercial decisions. You own everything in between. The daily and weekly execution rhythm that determines whether buyers stay, grow, and reorder is your accountability.
 



*If you are someone who has spent years in merchandising and has now moved — or is ready to move — from doing the work to managing the function, this role was built for you.* 




  





  





**Experience** 




 ● 8–12 years in garment or knitwear merchandising, with at least 3 years in a senior or managerial role managing a team and multiple accounts simultaneously.
 



 ● Direct experience with domestic retail brand accounts — Westside, Zudio, Max, Myntra, Clovia, DaMensch, or comparable. You understand how domestic retail buyers operate, what their timelines look like, and how their teams are structured.
 



 ● Strong TNA management — you have built TNA calendars, tracked them across concurrent orders, and held your team accountable against them. You know what a missed milestone costs.
 



 ● ERP comfort — you are used to working within a system and understand that what is not in the system does not exist.
 



  





**The kind of person we are looking for** 




 ● You manage the function, not just the accounts. You are not the person chasing fabric or writing every buyer email — you are the person who ensures your team does those things correctly and on time.
 



 ● You communicate clearly and do not leave room for misunderstanding — with buyers, with the factory, and with your team. You know when to call versus email, and your emails can be forwarded without editing.
 



 ● You are comfortable holding difficult buyer conversations — delivering bad news, managing a delay, proposing a solution — without escalating to your manager first.
 



 ● You are disciplined about documentation. If you left tomorrow, your team could pick up your accounts from what is in the system.
 



 ● You are based in Tirupur or genuinely willing to relocate. This is an on\-site role.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 ● A direct reporting line to the Managing Director — not a VP layer above you. Your decisions matter and your inputs are heard.
 



 ● Three active brand accounts already running, a merchandising team already in place, and a clear mandate to improve how the function performs — you are not starting from zero.
 



 ● A company genuinely in growth mode — new buyers, new product categories, improving systems — and a role that will grow with it.
 



 ● Competitive compensation discussed at interview. We are serious about this hire and will pay accordingly.

title: Business Development & AI Operations Manager
description:
﻿
 
 📢
 **WE’RE HIRING: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT \& AI OPERATIONS MANAGER** 




 📍
 **Location:** 
 Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 🏢
 **Company:** 
 Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 



 🏭
 **Industry:** 
 Apparel Manufacturing \| E\-commerce \| Retail
 



 💰
 **Salary:** 
 ₹20,000 – ₹35,000 per month
 



 🧑‍💼
 **Experience:** 
 1–7 Years
 



 We are looking for a proactive and technology\-oriented
 **Business Development \& AI Operations Manager** 
 who can work closely with management across
 **business growth, AI\-enabled workflows, hiring, employee coordination and day\-to\-day administration** 
 .
 



 This is a cross\-functional role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, learning new tools and improving how work gets done.
 


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
**1\. Business Development \& Growth** 




 • Identify new customers, partnerships, sales channels and business opportunities
 



 • Research B2B, wholesale, retail, institutional and e\-commerce opportunities
 



 • Generate leads and conduct follow\-ups
 



 • Approach prospective customers and business partners
 



 • Coordinate meetings, proposals, quotations and commercial discussions
 



 • Assist management with negotiations and business closures
 



 • Maintain and regularly update business development pipelines
 



 • Research competitors, pricing, products and market opportunities
 



 • Identify new revenue opportunities for the company
 



**2\. AI\-Enabled Business Operations** 




 A major part of this role will involve using modern AI tools to make everyday business activities faster and more effective.
 



 The candidate should be comfortable working with tools such as:
 



 • ChatGPT
 



 • Gemini
 



 • Claude
 



 • Microsoft Copilot
 



 • AI research and productivity tools
 



 • AI presentation and documentation tools
 



 • Workflow automation tools
 



 AI may be used for:
 



 • Business and competitor research
 



 • Lead generation and qualification
 



 • Drafting emails, proposals and reports
 



 • Preparing presentations
 



 • Data analysis
 



 • Recruitment and candidate screening
 



 • Creating SOPs and documentation
 



 • Administrative work
 



 • Process improvement
 



 • Internal productivity and automation
 



 The candidate does
 **not need to be a programmer** 
 , but should be curious about technology and capable of quickly learning new AI tools.
 



**3\. Recruitment \& Hiring** 




 • Understand manpower requirements from management
 



 • Create and publish job openings
 



 • Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed and other platforms
 



 • Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate calls
 



 • Shortlist suitable candidates
 



 • Schedule and coordinate interviews
 



 • Follow up with selected candidates
 



 • Coordinate offer and joining processes
 



 • Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate pipelines
 



 • Help ensure vacancies are filled quickly with suitable candidates
 



**4\. New Employee Onboarding \& Handling** 




 • Coordinate joining formalities
 



 • Collect employee documents and required information
 



 • Explain responsibilities, expectations and reporting structure
 



 • Coordinate initial training with departments
 



 • Follow up with employees during their initial period
 



 • Identify onboarding or performance issues and escalate them to management
 



 • Help new employees settle into their roles effectively
 



**5\. Employee \& Department Coordination** 




 • Handle routine employee discussions and coordination
 



 • Act as a communication bridge between management and employees
 



 • Follow up on attendance, leave and assigned responsibilities
 



 • Coordinate pending tasks across departments
 



 • Assist in resolving routine workplace issues
 



 • Maintain basic HR and employee records
 



 • Improve accountability and follow\-up across teams
 



**6\. Business Administration** 




 • Handle day\-to\-day administrative activities
 



 • Coordinate between management and different departments
 



 • Follow up on management instructions and pending work
 



 • Maintain important documents, trackers and records
 



 • Coordinate meetings, appointments and internal communication
 



 • Communicate with vendors and external service providers when required
 



 • Prepare management reports and updates
 



 • Identify recurring administrative problems and improve processes
 


 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
 • 1–7 years of relevant experience
 



 • Strong communication and people\-handling skills
 



 • Good spoken and written English
 



 • Comfortable speaking with candidates, employees, customers and business partners
 



 • Strong follow\-up and organisational ability
 



 • Good working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets
 



 • Comfortable using computers and digital platforms
 



 • Regular exposure to AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or similar platforms
 



 • Ability to independently research and solve problems
 



 • Ability to handle multiple responsibilities simultaneously
 



 • Comfortable working directly with management
 



 • Curious, adaptable and willing to learn new technology
 



 Experience in
 **business development, recruitment, HR, administration, apparel, textiles, e\-commerce, retail or consumer products** 
 will be an advantage.
 


 IDEAL PERSON FOR THIS ROLE
 
 We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between:
 



**Research → AI Tools → Business Development → Hiring → Employee Coordination → Administration → Follow\-up → Problem Solving → Execution** 




 This is not a narrowly defined desk role.
 



 The person should be able to understand a business objective, identify the right tools or people required, execute the work and follow it through until completion.
 


 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
 
 Performance will be measured through:
 



 • New business opportunities identified
 



 • Quality of business research
 



 • Lead and customer follow\-up
 



 • Recruitment speed and candidate quality
 



 • Successful employee onboarding
 



 • Completion of administrative responsibilities
 



 • Internal coordination and follow\-up
 



 • Adoption of AI tools within everyday workflows
 



 • Process improvements implemented
 



 • Ability to independently solve operational problems
 


 COMPENSATION
 
 💰
 **₹20,000 – ₹35,000 per month** 




 Final salary will depend on:
 



 • Experience
 



 • Communication skills
 



 • Business development capability
 



 • Recruitment and employee\-handling experience
 



 • Administrative ability
 



 • AI and technology exposure
 



 • Ability to independently take ownership of responsibilities
 



 Candidates who demonstrate strong performance and take broader responsibility will have opportunities to grow into larger management roles within the organisation.
 



 📩
 **To Apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume and mention:
 



 • Current Salary
 



 • Expected Salary
 



 • Notice Period
 



 • Current Location
 



 • Business Development Experience
 



 • Recruitment / Administration Experience
 



 •
 **AI tools you currently use and how you use them in your work**
